finding.title: A gift card redeemed in two carts at once is spent twice
finding.explanation: applyGiftCard reads the card's balance, then writes back `card.balance - amount` as an absolute value. Two checkouts using the same code can both read a balance of 50, both apply 50 to their carts, and both write 0. The card pays 100 out of a 50 balance.
finding.reasoningSummary: The read and the write are separate statements outside a transaction, and the write is not conditional on the balance it read. Gift card codes are shared by design (gifts), so concurrent use is expected, not an edge case.

evidence.text: Two carts apply code GIFT-7Q2M (balance 50) 3 ms apart. Both read 50, both take 50 off their totals, both write balance 0.
